{
  "subject": "portrait",
  "main_subject": "a person wearing a checkered protective beekeeping suit and hat, looking at the camera",
  "lighting": "soft, warm natural light from the side, suggesting golden hour",
  "color_tone": "warm white balance with a slight yellow cast, earthy and natural tones",
  "contrast": "medium",
  "issues": [
    "slight underexposure in the shadows of the suit",
    "background is very blurred and lacks detail"
  ],
  "style_directions": [
    "Enhance the warm, golden hour feel with a subtle warm tone grade",
    "Increase clarity and texture on the beekeeping suit to highlight the checkered pattern",
    "Apply a vignette to draw focus to the subject's eyes",
    "Slightly boost saturation on the background greens and yellows for a more vibrant look"
  ]
}

picks.reason: This preset perfectly targets the skin tones (Oranges) with a hue shift and desaturation while opening up the deep shadows in the hat brim and clothing, creating a natural, flattering look.
With a stronger clarity and shadow lift, this preset enhances the texture of the beekeeper suit while recovering the details in the dark fabric, fitting the outdoor subject well.
The split toning in this preset complements the green background by adding cyan shadows and yellow-green highlights, and its muted yellow channel helps the suit blend naturally into the scenery.
